name: BIEN
description: Occurrences, inventories, traits, and phylogenies of plants from the New World.

name: CESTES
description: 80 datasets of empirical trait-environment relationships from 1996 to 2018.

name: CoRRE Trait Data
description: 17 categorical and continuous traits for 4079 grassland species worldwide.

name: FRED
description: Fine-root functional traits organized in a common framework.

name: FungalRoot
description: Global database of plant mycorrhizal associations including colonization intensity.

name: GloBI
description: Open access to biotic interaction data: predator-prey, pollinator-plant, parasite-host.

name: MycoDB
description: Plant biomass responses to mycorrhizal inoculation with meta-analysis metrics.

name: Open Traits Network
description: Standardizes and integrates trait data across all organisms.

name: PLANTS Database
description: Vascular plants, mosses, and lichens of the U.S. and territories.

name: Seed Information Database
description: Global compilation of seed biological trait data.

name: TRY
description: Global database of curated plant traits. One of the most widely used in functional ecology.

name: Global Aridity Index
description: Global aridity index and potential evapotranspiration at high spatial resolution (v2).

name: WorldClim
description: High-resolution global climate data with bioclimatic variables for niche modeling.

name: GBIF
description: Global platform with free access to species occurrence records.

name: BioTIME
description: Global database of time series of assemblages to quantify biodiversity change.

name: Web of Life
description: Ecological network database: pollination, herbivory, host-parasite interactions.

name: GenBank
description: NIH genetic sequence database covering all organisms.

name: Movebank
description: Global repository of animal movement and migration data with visualization tools.

name: eBird
description: Global bird observation database maintained by Cornell Lab. API and downloadable data.

name: GloNAF
description: Naturalized alien plant species lists by region. Key for biological invasion studies.

name: POWO
description: Taxonomy, distribution, traits, and uses of vascular plants worldwide (Kew).

name: InvaCost
description: Global estimation of the economic cost of biological invasions per species.

name: KNB
description: International repository for ecological and environmental research data (NSF 1998).

name: EDI
description: Environmental data following FAIR principles for accessibility and reusability.

name: NEON
description: Network of U.S. field sites with standardized terrestrial and aquatic ecological data (NSF).

name: MammalBase
description: Traits, measurements, and diets of mammal species for macroecology and paleontology.
